title: FAUST-XXII. Deuteration in the VLA1623-2417 protostellar hot-corinos, cavities, and streamers
question: How deuterated is formaldehyde (HDCO/H2CO, D2CO/H2CO) in the VLA1623-2417 hot corino, outflow cavities and streamers, and is deuteration inherited from the prestellar stage

data.bands: Band 6 (216–234 GHz) analysed; one Band 3 setup also observed but not analysed
data.angular_resolution: Continuum beams 0.42'' x 0.32'' (Setup 1) and 0.38'' x 0.34'' (Setup 2); line-cube beams are listed in Table 1
data.sensitivity: Continuum rms 0.26 mJy/beam (Setup 1) and 0.27 mJy/beam (Setup 2); line-cube rms are listed in Table 1

evidence.quote: located in Ophiuchus A at a distance of 131$\pm$1 pc (cite: Gagne2018)

what.value: Outflow cavity walls traced in CS(5-4), overplotted on channel maps

evidence.loc: Streamers and Outflow Cavities in H2CO emission
evidence.quote: we draw in magenta the outflow cavity walls probed by CS(5–4) emission (cite: Ohashi2022)

what.value: Disk position angles of VLA1623 A1/A2 (~48-49 deg) and B (~42 deg) from high-resolution continuum maps

evidence.loc: Compact H2CO emission towards VLA1623 A, B, and W
evidence.quote: $\sim 48-49^\circ$ for VLA1623 A1 and A2, and $\sim 42^\circ$ for VLA1623 B, from the high-resolution continuum maps by (cite: Harris2018)

what.value: Illumination of VLA1623-2417 by two nearby B stars (HD147889 and rho Oph AB), from infrared and extinction maps

evidence.loc: On the origin of D2CO extended emission
evidence.quote: These maps show that VLA1623-2417 is illuminated by two nearby B stars (HD147889 and $\rho$ Oph AB).

recipe.goal: Calibrate, self-calibrate and image the line cubes
recipe.method: Modified calibration pipeline in CASA, self-calibration on line-free continuum, continuum subtraction, 12m+7m merged tclean cubes with primary beam correction
key_parameters: Briggs robust = 0.5 for lines, -2.0 for bright continuum

recipe.method: Moment 0 maps and velocity channel maps of H2CO, HDCO and D2CO; components labelled A, B, W and I-VII by velocity range
Spectra extracted at the continuum peaks of A, B, W and at positions in the SE outflow cavity (VI) and southern streamer (VII)
key_parameters: For A and B, intensities integrated over blue- and red-shifted ranges to avoid absorption at systemic velocity

recipe.goal: Derive excitation temperature from HDCO line ratio
recipe.method: Intensity ratio of HDCO 4(1,4)-3(1,3) (38 K) and 4(2,2)-3(2,1) (63 K) gives Tex per component

recipe.goal: Derive column densities of H2CO, HDCO and D2CO
recipe.method: LTE optically thin column densities using the HDCO-derived Tex for all three species
assumptions: The three species probe the same component

recipe.method: D/H = 0.5 x N(HDCO)/N(H2CO) and D/H = sqrt(N(D2CO)/N(H2CO))

recipe.goal: Make intensity ratio maps and test origin of extended D2CO
recipe.method: HDCO/H2CO and D2CO/H2CO intensity ratio maps over velocity ranges of components V, VI, VII; D2CO moment 1 and 2 maps used to argue for photodesorption in a PDR rather than shocks
